ننتفي (form VIII)
# نَنْتَفِي (nantafī) /nan.ta.fiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَفَى (intafā)
# نَنْتَفِيَ (nantafiya) /nan.ta.fi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَفَى (intafā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
